tasks.finding: The report distinguishes the next test appointment from the full confirmation obligation. Its step-count screen uses the recorded estimate and test settings, and does not grant the controller future repair truth.

tasks.task: Identify an assumption that constrains the comparison
tasks.finding: CO₂ quantity/cadence are chosen scenario inputs. The 400 kg three-day ceiling and 836.4 kg seven-day ceiling can hide operational differences; the evidence plan requests supplier capability and logistics.
All 108 original/new selectable traces were checked against their embedded last-interval operands. The report records original run/source/period identities and links to immutable Sites group reports.
Physical checks can pass while a repair remains unconfirmed or capacity stays impaired. The report does not turn scoped checks or zero false alarms into empirical reliability.
Report controls operate entirely on saved local data. Existing Sites-to-simulation-and-back integration passed; the live application was reloaded with its original archive.

misunderstandings_and_corrections.risk: Equal output looks like equal controller quality
misunderstandings_and_corrections.change: Added the CO₂ inventory ceiling, ending inventories and exact-trace repeatability distinction.

misunderstandings_and_corrections.risk: Physical restoration looks like autonomous repair and verified capability
misunderstandings_and_corrections.change: Separated restoration, diagnostic confirmation, human work and remaining impairment throughout the publication.

misunderstandings_and_corrections.risk: A low plant-render time is treated as preview rendering performance
misunderstandings_and_corrections.change: Measured solar preview rendering separately and retained first-edit and active-batch timings.

misunderstandings_and_corrections.risk: Keyboard focus and long provenance text impede inspection
misunderstandings_and_corrections.change: Added explicit selection keys and narrow-screen wrapping after the pre-release presentation review.

remaining: Independent operator/user comprehension feedback has not been collected. Automated consistency and an agent review do not substitute for it.
